note: Observed cloud dataset projected to factual fields. Description, biography and image URLs are omitted; content_hash belongs to the original full row. Source observations are historical, not current promises.
limits: Apple public software search and app lookup metadata, with no account login. Search has one response per query/country, up to searchLimit requested records; Apple may return fewer or cap coverage. There is no pagination, complete market inventory, keyword search-volume metric, download count, revenue estimate, review text or historical version archive. App price is the upfront storefront price, not subscription or in-app purchase pricing. Countries select storefronts, not developer locations. Ratings and availability vary by country.
